newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Solel Boneh raises 25 mln shkls in tender.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Solel Boneh raises 25 mln shkls in tender.

text.p: Israel's Solel Boneh Building & Infrastructure Ltd raised an additional 25 million shekels in an issue of warrants, bringing the total proceeds of its initial public offering this week to 108 million shekels, an underwriter said on Friday.
The offering of 1.78 million warrants which closed on Thursday was oversubscribed by three times and closed at a price of 14 shekels per unit, Leader Securities Underwriting said in a statement.
The statement said orders totalled 60 million shekels and that subscribers would receive 26 percent of what they ordered.
Solel Boneh is Israel's leading construction contractor.
The main tranche of the public offering for warrants, shares and convertibles which closed on Wednesday raised 83 million shekels and was 45 times oversubscribed.
Leader said Solel Boneh expected to raise an additional 130 million shekels from the exercise of warrants and conversion of bonds within two years.
The share component gives the public 9.9 percent of equity, but the figure rises to 41.2 percent when fully diluted. Housing & Construction Holding Co owns the remainder of the shares.
The success of the IPO comes amid a revival of the new issues market in Tel Aviv following a rally in stock prices that began at the end of last year.
